studyMetadata.title: Color Preferences Study
studyMetadata.description: An interactive study for understanding people's color preferences in data visualizations. Participants view pairs of color palettes along with example visualizations, one on the left and one on the right, displayed side-by-side, and rate their preference between the two using a slider.
